mechanics.claim: The Active heals Sona and sends a tone to heal the most wounded allied champion nearby, based on greatest % missing health.
mechanics.quote: heals herself and sends out a tone to heal the {{tt|most wounded|Based on greatest % missing health}} allied champion nearby

mechanics.claim: If no ally is injured, the heal targets the closest allied champion instead.
mechanics.quote: If no one is injured, ''Aria of Perseverance'' will target the closest allied champion.

mechanics.claim: Sona and allies tagged by a Power Chord bonus receive a shield lasting 1.5 seconds.
mechanics.quote: '''Sona''' and tagged allied champions are granted a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Sona gains a stack of Accelerando (a self-buff) whenever she heals a wounded ally or shields a minimum amount of damage for an ally with this ability.
mechanics.quote: '''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' whenever she {{tip|heals}} a wounded ally or {{tip|shields}} a minimum amount of damage for an ally

mechanics.claim: The Power Chord Diminuendo bonus reduces the target's damage output for a short time, which reduces damage dealt in the survival fight if Sona is the attacker's target of interest.
mechanics.quote: ''Power Chord'' reduces the target's [[size]] and damage output for a short time
